doc.selected: whether this chip is selected or not
doc.onClick: called when this chip is clicked
doc.label: text label for this chip
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this chip
doc.enabled: controls the enabled state of this chip. When `false`, this component will not respond to user input, and it will appear visually disabled and disabled to accessibility services.
doc.leadingIcon: optional icon at the start of the chip, preceding the [label] text. When [selected] is true, this icon may visually indicate that the chip is selected (for example, via a checkmark icon).
doc.trailingIcon: optional icon at the end of the chip
doc.shape: defines the shape of this chip's container, border (when [border] is not null), and shadow (when using [elevation])
doc.colors: [SelectableChipColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this chip in different states. See [FilterChipDefaults.elevatedFilterChipColors].
doc.colors.containerColor: the container color of this chip when enabled
doc.colors.labelColor: the label color of this chip when enabled
doc.colors.iconColor: the color of this chip's start and end icons when enabled
doc.colors.disabledContainerColor: the container color of this chip when not enabled
doc.colors.disabledLabelColor: the label color of this chip when not enabled
doc.colors.disabledLeadingIconColor: the color of this chip's start icon when not enabled
doc.colors.disabledTrailingIconColor: the color of this chip's end icon when not enabled
doc.colors.selectedContainerColor: the container color of this chip when selected
doc.colors.disabledSelectedContainerColor: the container color of this chip when not enabled and selected
doc.colors.selectedLabelColor: the label color of this chip when selected
doc.colors.selectedLeadingIconColor: the color of this chip's start icon when selected
doc.colors.selectedTrailingIconColor: the color of this chip's end icon when selected
doc.elevation: [SelectableChipElevation] used to resolve the elevation for this chip in different states. This controls the size of the shadow below the chip. Additionally, when the container color is [ColorScheme.surface], this controls the amount of primary color applied as an overlay. See [FilterChipDefaults.filterChipElevation].
doc.elevation.elevation: the elevation used when the chip is has no other [Interaction]s
doc.elevation.pressedElevation: the elevation used when the chip is pressed
doc.elevation.focusedElevation: the elevation used when the chip is focused
doc.elevation.hoveredElevation: the elevation used when the chip is hovered
doc.elevation.draggedElevation: the elevation used when the chip is dragged
doc.elevation.disabledElevation: the elevation used when the chip is not enabled
doc.border: the border to draw around the container of this chip. Pass `null` for no border. See [FilterChipDefaults.filterChipBorder].
doc.interactionSource: an optional hoisted [MutableInteractionSource] for observing and emitting [Interaction]s for this chip. You can use this to change the chip's appearance or preview the chip in different states. Note that if `null` is provided, interactions will still happen internally.
